description: Save the simulation workspace this credential is connected to as it stands now, under a name, so restore_simulation_snapshot can return to it later (for example before trying two ways of receiving the same purchase order). A full copy of the workspace's data and its simulated clock; a workspace keeps up to 10 named snapshots.

name.description: The snapshot's name, unique in the workspace (at most 100 characters).

name: create_simulation_snapshot
title: Create Simulation Snapshot
